summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with weakness, chills, abdominal pain, and diarrhea in the setting of relapsed multiple myeloma and recent cytopenias. He had recently resumed Ninlaro and Revlimid after completing radiation for a perivesicular plasmacytoma, but treatment was held due to infection concerns. Workup revealed no active C. difficile or other infectious source, and CT imaging showed no change in the known pelvic mass. His symptoms improved with supportive care, including IV fluids, pain management, and antibiotics, which were later discontinued. He received two units of packed red blood cells for chemotherapy-related anemia and showed improvement in renal function, likely due to volume repletion. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to follow up with oncology and to hold Revlimid until further guidance.
